# Shortomation

> Shortomation makes Apple Shortcuts kits, Notion templates, courses and consulting that automate Notion workspaces, for individual power users and teams. Run by Nazar Zhmurko from Ukraine.

## Products and services

- [Shortcut kits](https://nazarzhmurko.com/shortcuts/): ready-made Apple Shortcuts kits for Notion, sold on Gumroad (https://nazarzhmurko.gumroad.com)
- [Courses](https://nazarzhmurko.com/courses/): "Automate Notion with Siri Shortcuts: Master Notion API + ChatGPT API Integration"
- [Consulting](https://nazarzhmurko.com/consulting/): custom Notion shortcut kits built for your workflows, and 1:1 coaching and support

## Learn

- [Blog](https://nazarzhmurko.com/blog/): guides on building and debugging Apple Shortcuts for Notion
